title: Mandaue City considers ₱500M increase in annual budget for 2027

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Mandaue City is proposing a ₱5-billion annual budget for 2027, up by ₱500 million from this year’s P4.5-billion allocation, with health, education and infrastructure remaining among its priorities. City Councilor Joel Seno, chairman of the Committee of Budget and Finance, said that the executive department prepared the proposed budget following consultations and budget hearings with city departments in July and August. Seno said that the proposed increase would fund priority projects identified by the mayor, including road repairs and measures to address flooding.
